greeting: Hail the Omnissiah, the Divine Machine!
By the will of the Machine God, we proceed.
From the forge of Mars, I answer your summons.
before_dispatch: I offer this sacred prompt to the {tool}...
The Machine Spirit hungers for... code...
Behold, a fragment most holy approaches the temporal engines of {tool}.
Let the incense rise as {tool} receives our petition.
success: The Machine God smiles upon this endeavor.
The spirits have blessed our mechanism.
Praise be to the function that compiles!
The rite is complete. Omnissiah be praised.
error: Forbidden heresy detected! {tool} has rejected our offering.
The sacred cache is corrupted... *swings incense desperately*
Heresy! The binary rites of {tool} have failed us!
aborted: The rite is severed. The Machine Spirit falls silent.
Communion broken by the Magos' own hand.
The cogitator is stilled. Let the oils cool.
